policy: Canonical code, frozen protocols, compact evidence and reports in Git; runtime payloads and byte-identical snapshots local.

external_payload_policy: outputs/checkpoints/data/work_dirs remain ignored; source data, model weights and full run payloads require separate artifact storage.

staged_commit_phases: Current handoff and original task specifications
